Allows guest read-only socket & authenticated socketToken handshake; rejects tampered/non-string tokens
Broadcasts sanitized NEW_REPORT, REPORT_VOTED, NEW_REPORT_UPDATE, REPORT_RESOLVED, REPORT_PURGED, and targeted GEOFENCE_ALERT
Rejects unauthenticated calls with 401 across all protected routes
Rejects expired, malformed, wrong-secret, alg=none, and socketToken tokens on REST requireAuth routes
Issues HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookies and immediately blocks banned users across REST, refresh, and Socket.IO
Vertical privilege boundary: USER & VERIFIED_RESPONDER receive 403 on all ADMIN endpoints
Horizontal BOLA/IDOR: User B cannot resolve User A report, delete User A alert zone, or attach media to User A report
Ban authorization guard: non-admin USER receives 403 trying to ban a target while ADMIN succeeds (200)
Enforces .strict() mass-assignment/unknown-field rejection on strict schemas
PostGIS geofence validation: rejects unclosed, self-intersecting, >25 km² polygons, and >5 zones per user
Report, Media & GPS header boundaries (lat/lng extremes, 5MB limit, MIME types, incomplete GPS headers)
Prevents SSRF & path traversal on POST /api/v1/media/confirm
Rejects spoofed HTML payloads & mismatched magic-byte headers on POST /api/v1/media/mock-upload
Enforces rate limit on POST /api/v1/auth/login (429 after 10 attempts per IP)
Parameterizes SQL/PostGIS inputs and avoids secret leakage on SQLi/XSS probes
Enforces unique Vote constraint under concurrent identical requests (no double-counting)
Trust Engine atomic threshold: 5 distinct downvotes trigger PURGED status & -15 author trustScore
Ban transaction atomically marks ALL RefreshToken rows revoked in PostgreSQL
E2E Onboarding -> KYC Approval -> Role Promotion -> Cooldown Exemption -> Third-Party Resolve
E2E Hazard Routing Lifecycle: Active HIGH hazard triggers detour -> RESOLVED removes hazard from safe-path
Deterministic fuzzing (30 seeded mutations) yields zero 500 crashes and zero info leaks
Measures bounded concurrency latency (P50/P90/P95/P99 & RPS) across core read/compute endpoints
[BACKEND-001] Unauthenticated calls to /api/v1/cron/news-crawl must NOT exhaust authenticated cron rate-limit quota on same IP
[BACKEND-002] /auth/login should not leak refreshToken in JSON, /auth/refresh must rotate refreshToken, and /auth/logout must work with expired accessToken
[BACKEND-003] JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET in .env must be >= 32 characters without hardcoded fallbacks
[BACKEND-004] POST /api/v1/reports must reject empty string "" and >1000-char description with 400
[BACKEND-005] POST /api/v1/reports/:id/updates must reject whitespace-only content with 400
[BACKEND-006] GET /api/v1/safe-zones must return 400 for non-numeric spatial parameters (?lat=abc&lng=def)
[BACKEND-007] Missing resource IDs on /reports/:id/vote, /alerts/zones/:id, and /users/verify/:id/approve must return 404 (not 400)
[BACKEND-008] Repeat sign-in on POST /api/v1/auth/device for existing anonymousId should return 200 OK instead of 201 Created
[BACKEND-009] API contract consistency: /media/webhook uses {success,data}, /admin/logs rejects limit>100, and /safe-zones distanceMeters is a number
[BACKEND-010] Admin verification rejection must record a distinct rejection ModerationLog.action instead of VERIFY_USER
[BACKEND-011] POST /api/v1/reports and POST /api/v1/reports/:id/vote must NOT expose reporter userId PII in response JSON
[BACKEND-012] GET /api/v1/reports must reject inverted bounds (minLng >= maxLng or minLat >= maxLat) with 400
[BACKEND-013] POST /api/v1/admin/users/:id/ban must forbid self-banning and peer-ADMIN suspension (403)
[BACKEND-014] POST /api/v1/alerts/zones must reject topologically invalid self-intersecting polygons (ST_IsValid) with 400
[BACKEND-001] POST /cron/news-crawl ordering, unref cleanup timer, and all newly added route rate limiters enforce 429
[BACKEND-002] Login omits accessToken & refreshToken JSON, /refresh rotates DB row & cookie, expired-access /logout revokes DB row & clears cookies
[BACKEND-003] Booting env.ts fails closed when JWT_SECRET or JWT_REFRESH_SECRET is empty or < 32 chars
[BACKEND-004 & BACKEND-005] Report description & update content enforce exact whitespace/1000-char boundaries
[BACKEND-006 & BACKEND-012] Strict spatial coordinate bounds, trailing garbage, and inverted bounding box checks
[BACKEND-009 & BACKEND-010] Envelopes (/health*, /), strict /admin/logs & /analytics/trends params, legacy approve UUID validation & action filter
